title: NEMA 17 motor mounting plate
prompt: Mounting plate for a NEMA 17 stepper, CNC'd from 5 mm aluminium. 50 x 50 mm with a 22 mm hole in the middle for the motor's centering boss, and four M3 clearance holes on the standard 31 mm square pattern around it.

hidden_tests.description: Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
Exactly one solid body (one printable part)
50 x 50 mm plate, 5 mm thick, ±0.1 mm
One 22 mm pilot hole for the motor boss (up to 0.6 mm oversize for clearance)
Four M3 clearance holes (3.2–3.5 mm) on a 31 mm square
The 31 mm square is centred on the pilot hole
Five cylindrical hole walls and no other round faces

notes: NEMA 17: 31 mm hole spacing, 22 mm pilot boss. M3 clearance 3.4 (ISO 273 medium).
